accessibilityTree.description:
- document:
  - text: LegacyCore Portal - Member Administration System [PROD-US-EAST]
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - 'row "Navigation Menu Member Search Claims Queue Show Maintenance Notice Query Member Database Member ID: State / Region: All Regions Search Clear External Auditing Sub-Queue (Embedded Frame): Claims audit queue"':
        - cell "Navigation Menu Member Search Claims Queue Show Maintenance Notice":
          - text: Navigation Menu
          - list:
            - listitem:
              - link "Member Search":
                - /url: /portal/search
            - listitem:
              - link "Claims Queue":
                - /url: /portal/claims
            - listitem:
              - link "Show Maintenance Notice":
                - /url: /portal/maintenance
        - 'cell "Query Member Database Member ID: State / Region: All Regions Search Clear External Auditing Sub-Queue (Embedded Frame): Claims audit queue"':
          - text: Query Member Database
          - table:
            - rowgroup:
              - row "Member ID:":
                - cell "Member ID:"
                - cell:
                  - textbox
              - 'row "State / Region: All Regions"':
                - cell "State / Region:"
                - cell "All Regions":
                  - combobox:
                    - option "All Regions" [selected]
                    - option "California"
                    - option "New York"
                    - option "Texas"
              - row "Search Clear":
                - cell
                - cell "Search Clear":
                  - button "Search"
                  - button "Clear"
          - text: "External Auditing Sub-Queue (Embedded Frame):"
          - iframe
